algorithm.description: Couple/name-pair compatibility. Deterministic arithmetic; verdict text is a fixed lookup table keyed by remainder.
steps: total = ebcedSum(nameA) + ebcedSum(nameB)  (each name's own letter-by-letter Ebced sum, same method as calculateAbjad)
verdict = VERDICT_TABLE[remainder]  (special case: if total == 0, verdict = 'İsim Yok' / no name entered)
